calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --host dev --worktree --cli claude --task r1 --json
mu task close r1 -w eval --evidence 'the remote worker reported (CLOSE block); its commit is merged'
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"

text: r1 ran on dev, its commit is merged into main and the remote working copy is removed.
